nws_afd.quote: Clearing tonight will allow for temperatures to cool off efficiently, and lead to our coldest night in recent months, with lows dipping down into the upper 40s to lower 50s for some of the higher inland valleys. With antecedent rainfall, there could also be some areas of patchy radiational fog also developing within some of the higher valleys.

alerts.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued October 12 at 11:41AM PDT until October 13 at 2:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Minor coastal flooding due to morning high tides around 7
feet in combination with surf 3-6 feet, with local sets to 7
feet.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas and Orange County
Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...Until 2 PM PDT Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of lots, parks, and roads during morning
high tides with only isolated road closures expected.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Highest high tide will occur between 10 AM
and 11 AM Tuesday. High tide will fall below 7 ft by Wednesday
and below 6.5 ft after Thursday's highest high tide.
